name: Lvgl → On Idle
description: LVGL has a notion of screen inactivity -- i.e. the time since the last user interaction with the screen is tracked. This can, for example, be used to dim the display backlight or turn it off after a moment of inactivity (like a screen saver). Every use of an input device (touchscreen, rotary encoder) counts as an activity and resets the inactivity counter.

config_entries.label: Timeout
config_entries.description: [Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types/#time) that has elapsed since the last touch event, after which the trigger will be invoked.
